RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither does selecting another woman establish or rule out discrimination.

Your stronger publication record and completed PhD justify asking how the criteria were applied, but industry experience, teaching assessments and interview performance may legitimately matter.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment and any available comparative explanation. Check whether a completed PhD was mandatory and whether review or appeal deadlines apply; don’t let those expire while awaiting a reply.

Focus on documented inconsistencies or procedural failures, not the panel’s sex composition.
